definitions.loc: number of newline bytes, matching wc -l; binary tracked blobs are included in total LOC
definitions.go_runtime: tracked .go files excluding *_test.go and tools/**; this authoritative-compatible mechanical set includes internal/testutil
definitions.ui_runtime: ui/admin/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}, excluding *.test.{ts,tsx} and ui/admin/src/test/**; CSS is included
definitions.exported_go_declarations: exported type declarations plus exported free-function and method declarations in the Go runtime file set, counted with go/ast
definitions.constructors: free-function declarations whose names begin with New in the Go runtime file set
definitions.go_comments: Go runtime lines whose trimmed text begins with //
definitions.ui_comments: comment-only lines beginning with //, /*, or {/* plus continuation lines inside a block comment; runtime, all-source, and legacy-regex totals are reported separately
definitions.page_hooks: direct useState/useEffect call tokens outside comments and strings in ui/admin/src/pages/** runtime files
definitions.ui_exports: UI runtime top-level export statement lines, not the number of individually exported symbols
definitions.long_production_files: >800 newline bytes in a Go or UI runtime file
definitions.comparison_categories: runtime=the authoritative-compatible Go/UI runtime sets (including internal/testutil); test=Go/Vitest/Playwright; support=tools/scripts/UI test helpers/migrations; generated=embedded UI dist; docs=docs/** plus root README/SECURITY; config=remaining tracked files; exact renames are counted as one deletion plus one addition so category movement remains visible

classification_notes.note: The authoritative mechanical non-test-Go file set includes internal/testutil/postgres.go (60 LOC) and its exported NewDatabase function. The comparison view uses the same classification so measured and compared runtime deltas reconcile; the strict product-only alternative remains recorded here.
83 is the authoritative count of export statement lines. It represents 84 exported names because one statement re-exports two names.

discrepancies.reason: The authoritative value is reproduced only by including 11 real comment lines from four Vitest files plus one CSS universal-selector false positive from the legacy prefix regex. That conflicts with the UI runtime/test exclusion boundary and is not a lexical runtime comment count.
